title: Exports pass CI on main
claim: Exports of a shop as worker jobs with five-minute signed downloads (story S13.2, pull request 52) passed CI on main in the run for commit 763309d. On a developer machine a shop with 200 000 entries was exported in about 16 seconds to a 34 MB workbook with a peak of 148 MB of memory; the file was opened in one copy of Microsoft Excel only, and the export was never run against a real object store
